items.prompt: An interface provides price_cents=1235 and quantity_shares=4. Which unit does their product have?
items.explanation: Cents per share times shares gives cents of notional. This simplified contract has no fees or fractional-share conversion.

options.text: Cents per share, still a price
options.why: Multiplying by shares produces an amount, not another per-share price.
The unit multiplication cancels shares and leaves cents.

options.text: Shares held, without a money value
options.why: Price contributes a money unit, so the product is not a share count.
